explanation: Babai–Seress Conjecture 1.7: there is an absolute C with diam(G) ≤ (log|G|)^C for every non-abelian finite simple group G. The group diameter is the max Cayley-graph diameter over generating sets, with symmetrized generators, which is the standard notion (Helfgott–Seress, Wikipedia). Generating sets ensure connectedness, so Mathlib's diam is meaningful. The statement is faithful and open.
